parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Describe how two metal plates could be used to produce the electric field. Numerical values are not required.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Determine the magnitude of the electric force acting on the bead.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Use your answer in (b) and the weight of the bead to show that the resultant force acting on it is $7.2 \times 10^{-5} \text{N}$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Explain why the resultant force on the bead of $7.2 \times 10^{-5} \text{N}$ is constant as the bead moves along path AB.

parts.label: (e)(i)
parts.text: Calculate the magnitude of the acceleration of the bead along the path AB.

parts.label: (e)(ii)
parts.text:
The path AB has length $0.58 \text{m}$.

Use your answer in (i) to determine the speed of the bead at point B.
